description: Born of dragons, as their name proclaims, dragonborn walk proudly through a world that greets them with incomprehension and fear.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.tldr: You have draconic heritage, determining your breath weapon type and damage resistance.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.tldr: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy matching your draconic ancestry.

features.name: Damage Resistance
features.tldr: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

features.name: Chromatic or Metallic Lineage
features.tldr: Choose your specific dragon type lineage to unlock specialized draconic magic.

features.name: Draconic Vigor
features.tldr: You channel your inner dragon's might to harden your scales or push through fatigue.

features.name: Apex Predator
features.tldr: Your breath weapon deals increased damage and your mastery over your dragon type deepens.
